miembro-mesa.fraseTacha: An objection is a legal action submitted by citizens against the appointment of certain voters selected as polling station members due to impediments established by the Organic Law of Elections – Law No. 26859 – Article 57. Through objections, it is sought to prevent selected members from participating on election day if they are affected by legal incompatibilities. After the provisional publication of the list of polling station members, the head of the Decentralized Office of Electoral Processes (ODPE) handles the objections submitted and forwards them to the Special Electoral Jury (JEE), after verifying proper justification

pop-causales.titulo: Reasons for submission to the JEE
pop-causales.actas-observadas: Reasons for submission to the JEE
pop-causales.sinDatoDesc: No votes are recorded in the 'Total Votes' column of an election, in the boxes corresponding to the voting.
pop-causales.inconpletaDesc: Does not indicate the total number of citizens who voted, either in letters or numbers, or lacks one or two sections of the record.
pop-causales.errorMaterialDesc: With inconsistencies in the numerical data recorded.
pop-causales.ilegibilidadDesc: Contains signs, symbols, or characters other than: 0–9, Ø, (.), (-), (/), (\/), (=), -o-, or combinations of these, smudges, or amendments that make it impossible to identify the numbers.
pop-causales.sinFirmasDesc: The electoral record lacks the minimum number of polling station member signatures as required, or notes the absence of a member without proper replacement.
pop-causales.votosImpugnadosDesc: Electoral record containing one or more votes that were contested either during voting (identity issues) or counting (vote objection).
pop-causales.solicitudNulidadDesc: Record from a polling station where a nullity request was submitted by accredited representatives. The request is noted in any of the three sections.
pop-causales.actaExtravidaDesc: Polling station record that, due to reasons other than violence, was not delivered to the ODPE or entered into the electoral computing system.
pop-causales.actaSiniestradaDesc: Record not delivered due to violence or attacks affecting electoral materials.
pop-causales.obsrvacionesMultiplesDesc: Record that presents a combination of the previously mentioned observations.
